[[File:Hawkeyes.png|250px|thumb|The Hawkeyes]]
The '''Hawkeyes''' were a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] group of [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and techs who were regarded as the best technicians on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] wished to hack Balmorra's Hawkeye controlled satellite systems from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. To do so, they had an individual talk to a Hawkeye named [[Iain Sarkus]]. As a result of this, Iain's fellow Hawkeyes were to be [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the Empire. Fortunately for them, this individual managed to rescue them just in time to avoid execution from the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
